body:
Resolve Wave 4 audit findings:
1. In CHANGELOG.md:
   - Under ## [Unreleased], document recent features and fixes:
     * Warm second-strike conversation resumption via agy --conversation (#25, AGB_WARM_STRIKES)
     * Centralized model-name registry in lib/models.mjs (#21)
     * Shared runAdlcTool() wrapper across 6 call sites (#20)
     * Mutation-killing test and branch coverage for lock reclaim guard (#41)
     * Release audit Wave 1-5 remediations.
   - On line 145, remove obsolete reference to '--unsafe-open' flag; document dynamic session token authentication.
2. In commands/agb-sidecar.md:
   - Update line 8 to clarify that the server prints the local host/port binding, while the full authenticated URL containing the token is registered into the dynamic sidecar plugin manifest. Instruct agents to background the command.
3. In website docs:
   - website/content/docs/reference/calibration.mdx (line 37): update probe model to Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low).
   - website/content/docs/reference/cli/probe.mdx (line 18): update default model to Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low).
   - website/content/docs/reference/cli/brains.mdx (line 12): update default brain path to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain.
   - website/content/docs/reference/mcp-tools.mdx (line 13): remove obsolete claim that MCP server sets AGB_PROVIDER=jetski.
   - website/content/docs/guides/headless-and-mcp.mdx (line 45): document agb_run.concurrency support.
   - website/content/docs/getting-started/verify.mdx (line 25): update Node.js requirement to >= 22.19.0.
   - website/content/docs/internals/run-lifecycle.mdx (line 40): document warm second-strike resumption.
   - website/env-docs.json (line 50): remove obsolete sentence stating MCP server sets AGB_PROVIDER to jetski.
4. In skills/release/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md, and .agents/skills/release/SKILL.md:
   - Reorder Step 3 so that updating CHANGELOG.md occurs before running 'node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs'.

Verification: node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check
title: Wave 4: Documentation, Command Specs, and Website Sync
